details.label: Scope:
details.text: Contributed to MLLM and agentic applications across TikTok, Doubao, and the local-services ecosystems, including an MLLM-driven spatial perception system based on in-cabin and dashcam imagery.

details.label: Key Work:
details.text: Applied VLM post-training techniques, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning, to support road-scene understanding, spatial generation, and AI agents.

details.label: Scope:
details.text: Contributed to multimodal search and educational AI systems in AI Assistant, spanning open-world image understanding, Vision-Grounded RAG, VLM post-training, and autonomous vision-language agents.

details.label: Key Work:
details.text: Worked on intent-aware, fine-grained vision-grounded RAG for AI search and feedback-driven reasoning with tool orchestration for educational agents. Also developed DORIS to jointly detect and rank objects for recommendation in visual search.

details.label: Scope:
details.text: Contributed advanced computer vision solutions across cloud, mobile, and edge platforms for smart-city, transportation, and risk-control applications.

details.label: Key Work:
details.text: Developed edge-cloud collaborative multi-state visual perception for micro-mobility intelligent transportation platforms.
